about: A06 shot list: a Snap it. spot (see episodes/A01-just-sign).

shots.name: a06sofa
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in, no zoom, no cuts. At dusk a stylized 3D animated photographer is curled on her sofa hugging a cushion, nervously checking the street. Across the street a window lights up with a soft lavender glow, and a ribbon of glowing lavender sparkle dust drifts across and in through her window, curling around her phone. She gasps, jumps up with the cushion over her head, and cheers silently with a huge smile. Expressive animated performance, smooth character animation, warm light, Same faces, same clothes, same place, nothing morphs. Feels playful and a little magical. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fog, no fade, no mist, no smoke.

toast.title: Client opened their gallery for the first time

shots.name: a06m1
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera pulls back smoothly and quickly, up and away from the character, revealing the whole scene as a small cutaway diorama sitting on a pale lavender studio backdrop. Everyone stays exactly where they are, nobody walks, floats or grows. Only the camera moves. No cuts, no fades, no morphing, no dissolve.

shots.name: a06diorama
shots.prompt: Very slow, very slight push-in; the whole diorama stays in frame the entire time; no zoom, no cuts. On a small diorama of a cosy living room on a pale lavender backdrop, the tiny stylized 3D animated photographer bounces happily on the sofa with the cushion in the air; a soft lavender glow shines in the window. The diorama does not change shape. Same faces, same clothes, nothing drifts. Clean pale backdrop throughout, crisp, no haze, no fog. Feels light and satisfied.
